name: xray_grounding_tool
description: Analyzes chest X-ray images using GPT-4o vision. Detects abnormal findings (e.g., consolidation, pleural effusion, pneumothorax) and draws visual grounding bounding boxes on the regions of interest.

help.summary: GPT-4o chest X-ray analysis with visual grounding of abnormal findings.

modes.name: analyze
modes.description: Analyze chest X-ray and annotate abnormal regions with bounding boxes.

options.name: image_path
options.description: Path to the chest X-ray image (JPG or PNG).

options.name: save_annotated
options.description: If true, saves annotated image to outputs/. Default: true.

notes: Uses GPT-4o vision for abnormality detection and coordinate prediction.
Bounding boxes are drawn only when abnormal findings are detected.
